notes: The router uses this manifest for a FIRST GUESS, then confirms against real code before committing (ground-in-code principle).
The ecosystem guide is a prior, not the truth. Where this manifest and the guide disagree, code wins — corrections are noted per-repo.

repos.purpose: Next.js 14 web app + internal UI kit(s). What users see.
repos.correction: Guide says 'Vanilla Extract'. Real components use SCSS-modules (*.module.scss) + CVA (*.cva.ts). Code wins.

subPackages.note: This monorepo (yarn workspaces + turbo) contains TWO UI kits and the app. Pick the right one.

app.what: The Next.js 14 App Router application (confusingly named erp-next-fe, NOT the legacy repo).

uiKitV1.what: Older/current UI kit. Combobox reference lives here (lib/components/Combobox).

uiKitV2.what: UI Kit 2.0 — the target of the 'UI Kit 2.0' epic (PROJ-2622). Has real tests.

commands.install: yarn install  (requires NODE_AUTH_TOKEN GitHub PAT for private @acme-it-erp/* packages)

repos.purpose: Express 4 'modulith' REST API. Verifies JWT, enforces policies, orchestrates data via adapters.
repos.structure: No src/. app.ts + index.ts at root. Feature code in modules/, cross-cutting in shared/. Path aliases @distribution/* @inventory/* @auth/* @shared/*.
repos.correction: Never touches UniVerse directly — always via new CombinedAdapter<T>(ModelSpec, ctx). @types/express is v5 while Express is v4 (known skew). 500 handler leaks err.message (known issue).

commands.build: yarn build  (ts-node; PM2 transpiles at runtime, no dist shipped)

repos.purpose: Single source of truth for API types. One authored spec → 3 published packages (frontend/backend/schemas).
repos.correction: TWO specs: src/openapi/*.ts generates openapi.json (FE+BE types). generate:zod + backend validator read a SEPARATE, stale, hand-maintained openapi.yaml. README is stale — trust package.json + CHANGELOG. No auto-propagation: consumers must bump the dep.

commands.genZod: yarn generate:zod  (reads the stale openapi.yaml — must be updated too)

repos.dependencyRule: CONTRACT-FIRST: change here BEFORE its consumers (FE/BE), then bump the dep in each.

repos.purpose: Lerna+Nx monorepo. Repository-pattern adapters over UniVerse (via python-layer) + MongoDB, with dual-write. Also ships @acme-it-erp/logger + shared-utils used ecosystem-wide.
repos.correction: combined-adapter/package.json may contain an UNRESOLVED git merge conflict in peerDependencies — resolve before yarn install. Dir is combined-adapter but package is combine-adapter. universe-adapter is an HTTP client to the python-layer; it never opens a UniVerse socket.

commands.perPackage: yarn test:combinedAdapter | test:universeAdapter | test:mongodbAdapter | test:sharedUtils | test:logger

repos.purpose: The RBAC catalog: Policy.*, Permissions, Role enum + hierarchy, ROLE_PERMISSIONS, PolicyDefinition shape. Zero runtime deps. Consumed by FE + BE.
repos.correction: minAssurance and blockedBranches are declared but NOT enforced today. Role matching is plain string membership, not hierarchy-aware; hierarchy cascades only through permissions.

commands.verify: yarn verify  (lint + types; NO tests in this package)

repos.dependencyRule: When adding a permission: ship a policies release FIRST, then bump middleware.

repos.purpose: The auth engine (jose): verifyToken, decodeToken, extractToken, evaluatePolicy (401→403→403), projectPolicy. Pure functions. Consumed by FE + BE.
repos.correction: Despite the name it ships NO Express middleware — only pure functions. The backend writes its own requirePolicy wrapper. Pins a specific auth-policies version (version-skew aware).

repos.purpose: FastAPI service — the ONLY component that speaks UniVerse MultiValue (via uopy). Exposes /api/v1/universe/* over HTTP/JSON.
repos.correction: Requires FortiClient VPN to reach the UniVerse host (private address). Writes issue a redundant second W5RELEASE (flagged TEMP).

repos.purpose: Legacy 'Rosetta Stone' — MVBasic source, UniVerse dicts, legacy→modern field maps, screenshots. Knowledge base, NOT code.
repos.usage: CONSULT (read-only) when porting a legacy screen. Never imported at runtime, never built.

repos.purpose: Superseded Vite+React Router+Formik+TanStack SPA. Historical reference only.
repos.policy: DO NOT TOUCH. Never route new work here. If a ticket seems to point here, it almost certainly means the monorepo app instead — confirm with the user.
